# How the courses are ordered
Each course is a sequence of modules, and each module builds on the one before it, so do them in order. Lessons are the main steps. Activities are short practice tasks between lessons. Each course ends with a final project or challenge.

# IoT Foundations: the order to follow
1. IoT Lesson 1: What is IoT? (Module 1, the first lesson)
2. IoT Lesson 2: Temperature Sensor (Module 2)
3. Light sensor activity (Module 2)
4. Motion sensor activity (Module 2)
5. IoT Lesson 3: LED and Buzzer (Module 3)
6. Smart Night Light activity (Module 3)
7. IoT Lesson 4: Send Data to the Dashboard (Module 4, the last lesson)
8. Read the graph activity (Module 4)
9. Final project: Smart Room Alert (Module 5)
IoT Foundations has 4 lessons, 4 activities and 1 final project.

# Robotics Foundation: the order to follow
1. Robotics Lesson 1: Meet Your Robot (Module 1, the first lesson)
2. Robotics Lesson 2: Move and Turn (Module 2)
3. Robotics Lesson 3: Distance Sensor (Module 3)
4. Robotics Lesson 4: Line Following (Module 4, the last lesson)
5. Obstacle Course (Module 5)
6. Final challenge: Maze Runner (Module 6)
Robotics Foundation has 4 lessons, 1 obstacle course and 1 final challenge.

# Which course first
The two courses use different kits, so you can start with either one. Block coding basics, the workspace and the simulator are the same in both.
